render_protocol_resolution.selected_pickcube_status: renderer=none; no selected PickCube window or synchronized task-camera route is established
render_protocol_resolution.reset_capture_phase_gap: Current consumer config labels reset-initial capture post_control_step; future 5c must add call-time reset_initial identity. Not implementation evidence.
render_protocol_resolution.shared_scene_policy: Provider/session retains native scene/model/App ownership; renderer borrows a typed generation-bound limited lease and consumes only completed public state.
render_protocol_resolution.independent_renderer_policy: Renderer-owned visual model/data may perform required kinematics but no second physics advance and no mutation of live physics state.
render_protocol_resolution.rgb_policy: Canonical output must specify dimensions/layout/channel/color/range/dtype/device/completion/lifetime; owned storage by default, borrowed lease/fence explicit; zero/shape-only is not success.
render_protocol_resolution.batch_image_layout: env -> worker -> local row -> camera -> image; same-step terminal frame before mask reset, reset frame after reset; preserve terminal_observation/reset_info; never broadcast one worker frame as distinct row observations.
render_protocol_resolution.close_policy: Renderer stops capture/presentation and releases own resources/leases; original provider/App/worker owner closes shared resources after final lease.
